TravelVolume.label: Traveling volume
TravelVolume.geometry: Compact connected body with a directional rear
TravelVolume.motion: Transport across the body; flight follows the authoritative anchor

DirectedStream.label: Directed stream
DirectedStream.geometry: Start cap, length-adapted middle, contact cap
DirectedStream.motion: Flow along the axis; retain distinct instantaneous and held envelopes

ExpandingFront.label: Expanding front
ExpandingFront.geometry: Cone-sector or radial crest, with optional floor accent
ExpandingFront.motion: Cosmetic release front; never imply a delayed or traveling server hit

AreaEnvelope.label: Area and attached envelope
AreaEnvelope.geometry: Boundary plus interior layers, with a body-mounted variant
AreaEnvelope.motion: Stationary Field, following Aura, or attachment-local enhancement; shared motifs, distinct silhouettes

SurfaceAssembly.label: Surface and material assembly
SurfaceAssembly.geometry: Surface-aware shell and seams around the actual authored object
SurfaceAssembly.motion: Build, settle and dissolve; manipulation follows real target movement

Projectile.current: Composer comet/core/trail; generated identity kit. Fire alone selects the approved ConnectedFire body.
Projectile.exceptions: Homing orientation, pierce/chain/multishot, lingering variants and non-fire solid bodies retain their own motion and accents.

Beam.current: Composer BeamCore/BeamAura/helix; generated kit beam ribbons and end layers.
Beam.exceptions: Instant versus channeled timing; changing length/width and real contact position. Lightning branches are not fire ribbons recolored.

Wave.current: Composer linked Crest nodes; bespoke Body cone/crescents and generated kit wave layers.
Wave.exceptions: Cone versus radial/Sphere; repeated channel releases. Existing Wave hit checks happen in place; visual growth never changes their timing.

Field.current: Composer Boundary/Carpet; generated kit ground and ambient layers.
Field.exceptions: Ground or object placement, changing radius, pulse/expiry phases, and surface clipping. Proposed Soul field is a gallery fixture, not a new registered spell.

Aura.current: Composer Boundary/Orbit; generated kit shell and ambient layers.
Aura.exceptions: Follows the authoritative owner/target; must not look like a stationary ground field or obscure nearby combat.

SelfEnhancement.current: Composer linked Mantle; generated kit shell/ambient and bespoke Body shell layers.
SelfEnhancement.exceptions: Body-local attachments and toggle cancellation. A body mantle is not a scaled ground ring.

Construct.current: Composer Lattice and kit ambient layers supplement the actual server-created construct.
Construct.exceptions: Box, Sphere, Cylinder, Wedge, Arch, Pillar, Stairs, Bridge and Custom geometry; attachments and persistence. Never replace collision geometry with VFX.

Manipulation.current: Composer Lattice and kit ambient layers around the affected material/object.
Manipulation.exceptions: Matter-focused Raise/Lower and actual moved-object silhouette. Soul/Spirit does not support Manipulation and must not be silently substituted.

Rush.current: Composer comet (analyzer Rush = Comet): Rush.Core stretched by dash speed and a wide Rush.Streak trail on a stamped path riding the caster; Fire adds the hot core.
Rush.exceptions: The caster is the moving body: Dash travels the validated path; Blink flashes at the start and destination with no travel between.

Tether.current: Composer helix (analyzer Tether = Helix): thin Tether.Core and slow chain-like Tether.Links on a stamped path spanning both anchors, over the server's colored Beam.
Tether.exceptions: Both ends move: the path follows the anchors and the link count grows with MaxLength; a snap flashes at the midpoint.

cross_cutting: Homing, chain, pierce, summon and other mechanic accents

reference.status: Approved source reference; existing Studio integration preserved

prototype.status: Local geometry and motion study only; no gameplay integration or art approval
prototype.motion: Nested rising contours, inward drift and delayed echo; stable floor boundary; no fire texture reuse
